Role Overview: Architect RAG systems, LLM fine-tuning pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search engines, and AI agents.
Core Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain end-to-end technical solutions for Generative AI Engineer domain.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams to deliver scalable software features.
- Build clean, tested code and automated evaluation suites.

Required Key Technical Skills:
- Primary Languages: Python, SQL, C++, Java, Bash.
- Essential Tools & Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, FastAPI, Docker, Git, PostgreSQL, Pandas, NumPy.
- Core Domains: Data structures, algorithms, system design, data modeling, API integration.
